definitions.explanation: A small medical facility, typically run by a single doctor or small group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{医院|いいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a nearby clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧{医院|いいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{診|み}てもらった→診る：09798_miru⟧。
examples.english: I was examined at an internal medicine clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧{医院|いいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧。
examples.english: I made an appointment at the dental clinic.

notes:
{医院|いいん} refers to a small private clinic, typically run by a single doctor or a small group. Composed of {医|い} (medicine) + {院|いん} (institution).

TYPES:
- ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧{医院|いいん}: internal medicine clinic
- ⟦{歯科|しか}→歯科：11072_shika⟧{医院|いいん}: dental clinic
- ⟦{眼科|がんか}→眼科：11071_ganka⟧{医院|いいん}: eye clinic
- ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧{医院|いいん}: dermatology clinic
- ⟦{小児科|しょうにか}→小児科：08652_shounika⟧{医院|いいん}: pediatric clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {医院|いいん}: small private clinic (often a single doctor)
- ⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧: clinic (loanword, same scale as {医院|いいん})
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: hospital (larger facility with multiple departments, beds for inpatients)
- ⟦{診療所|しんりょうじょ}→診療所：14205_shinryoujo⟧: medical office/clinic (official term, often used in government/legal contexts)

In practice, {医院|いいん} and ⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧ are nearly interchangeable. Many clinics use one or the other in their name.
